title.narrative: Promotion and piloting of the UNESCO Recommendation on Ethics in AI

description.narrative:
Taking into account that Ecuador has announced itself as one of the first to adopt the UNESCO Recommendation on AI, the UNESCO Office in Ecuador, in close collaboration with the Santiago de Chile Office and the AI and Bioethics sections of the Headquarters, will promote and implement the two tools of the recommendation in Ecuador. Moreover, with relevant Ecuadorian stakeholders, case studies and materials that can be useful for government authorities, as well as for the private sector and civil society organizations, will be developed.
In alignment with UNESCO's directives, special attention will be given to bioethics. This will involve addressing ethical concerns in various fields and ensuring responsible development and application of technologies in general.
The UNESCO Quito Office will also focus on Artificial Intelligence (AI). This includes the promotion of the ethics of its implementation and enhancing women's participation in AI, recognizing the critical role of gender diversity in the development and application of AI technologies.
